sloka: आजघानेन्द्रजित् क्रुद्धो वज्रेणेव शतक्रतुः ।अङ्गदं गदया वीरं शत्रुसैन्यविदारणम् ।। ६.४३.१८ ।।।।
transliteration: ājaghānendrajit kruddho vajreṇeva śatakratuḥ ।aṅgadaṁ gadayā vīraṁ śatrusainyavidāraṇam ।। 6.43.18 ।।।।

translations.english: Enraged, Indrajith struck Angada with his mace, the destroyer of hostile forces which was like Indra who had done a hundred sacrifices, would strike with his thunderbolt.
